name: IndieHub

sources.title: IndieHub homepage — all-in-one directory for indie makers

requirements: No free plan shown on the pricing page — cheapest entry is Basic $4.9 (one-time)
Basic: 3 dofollow links, immediate listing, publish when you want, permanent link, no backlink required
Pro $9.9: 3+ dofollow links, immediate listing, featured placement at top of listings, social share to 7K+ followers
Sponsor $19.9/week: everything in Pro plus promotion on almost every page; one sponsor per period
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, URL, logo, categories/tags
workflow: Choose Basic, Pro, or Sponsor on the pricing page ('Go Submit')
Pay and fill the product form
Listing publishes immediately (no queue on paid plans)
watchFor: All listing tiers are paid — treat third-party 'free listing' claims for this site as stale
Dofollow links are the selling point; '3 dofollow links' suggests multiple outbound placements per listing
Tiny prices suggest Stripe-style one-time checkout; keep the receipt for link-lifetime disputes
Site is a demo/showcase of the operator's Mkdirs boilerplate — assess longevity before paying
countsAsLive: A public product page at indiehub.best/app/<slug> appearing in Products listings
unknowns: Whether a free tier ever existed or is offered on request
